description: A NOT NULL guard on one table's column must not narrow a different table's column of the same bare name

columns.name: d
columns.note: u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL proves nothing about o.deleted_at -- they are different columns that only share a bare name

name: case_guard_wrong_table_not_narrowed
query_sql:
-- @name GetOrderDeletion
-- @returns :many
SELECT CASE WHEN u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN o.deleted_at ELSE '1970-01-01' END AS d FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
CREATE TABLE orders (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
